title: Pocket Gnomes
description: Three magical wands. Three specialized gnomes. Build, farm, and hunt with charming little helpers.
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3eb6725cd917fdbd019d9ac2a4d3f1f646690b88.png)
**Tiny magical helpers for building, farming, and hunting in Minecraft.**

Pocket Gnomes adds **three magical wands** that summon specialized gnome helpers:
a **Builder**, a **Farmer**, and a **Hunter**.

Simple to learn, fun to use, and perfect for players who want a little magical automation in their world.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/qjWi-y_WLZo" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

---

## What Is Pocket Gnomes?

**Pocket Gnomes** is a **Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11** that lets you command tiny magical workers with unique roles.

With the right wand, you can:

- summon a **Builder Gnome** to construct structures
- summon a **Farmer Gnome** to create and maintain farms
- summon a **Hunter Gnome** to fight mobs, hunt animals, and collect loot

Each wand has its own identity, custom model, and purpose.

---

## Features

### Builder Gnomes
Use the **Builder Wand** to select an area and choose a structure preset.

Your gnome will appear and start building for you.

Included default structure presets:

- Small House
- Large House
- Stone Fortress
- Cottage
- Workshop
- Manor

You can also add your own custom presets with `.nbt` files.

### Farmer Gnomes
Use the **Farmer Wand** to mark a farm area and choose a crop mode.

Your farmer gnome will:

- prepare the land
- place fences and a chest
- plant crops
- replant after harvesting
- keep the farm running automatically

Available farm modes:

- Mixed Farm
- Wheat
- Carrot
- Potato
- Oak Saplings
### Compatible with the Farmer's Delight Refabricated mod. 
### Additional resources:
- Beetroot
- Cabbage
- Onion
- Tomato
- Rice

### Hunter Gnomes
Use the **Hunter Wand** to summon a combat helper.

Your hunter gnome will:

- patrol near your position
- attack hostile mobs
- hunt selected animals
- pick up drops
- store loot in your **Ender Chest**

### Undo Support
Made a mistake?

Use:

`/gnome undo`

to revert the latest builder or farmer action.

### Custom Presets
Add your own building presets by placing `.nbt` files in:

`config/gnomebuilders/presets`

They will appear automatically in the Builder Wand menu.

### Optional Farmers Delight Support
Pocket Gnomes supports additional crop modes when compatible crops are available.

---

## Crafting Recipes

All three wands use simple **shapeless crafting recipes**.

### Builder Wand
- Stick
- Oak Planks
- Crafting Table

### Farmer Wand
- Stick
- Wheat Seeds
- Wheat

### Hunter Wand
- Stick
- String
- Feather

---

## How To Use

### Builder Wand
1. Right-click one block to set the first point.
2. Right-click another block to set the second point.
3. Right-click in the air.
4. Choose a structure preset.
5. Your Builder Gnome starts construction.

### Farmer Wand
1. Right-click one block to set the first point.
2. Right-click another block to set the second point.
3. Right-click in the air.
4. Choose a farm mode.
5. Your Farmer Gnome starts working.

### Hunter Wand
1. Right-click in the air.
2. A Hunter Gnome spawns near you.
3. It patrols, fights, gathers loot, and delivers it to your Ender Chest.

---

## Commands

- `/gnome kit` - gives all three wands
- `/gnome wand builder` - gives the Builder Wand
- `/gnome wand farmer` - gives the Farmer Wand
- `/gnome wand hunter` - gives the Hunter Wand
- `/gnome undo` - reverts the latest builder or farmer action
- `/gnome remove hunter` - removes your active hunter gnomes

---

## Important Notes

- Builder and farmer gnomes **currently do not consume player resources**
- Builder gnomes **clear the selected build area before construction**
- Hunter gnomes deposit loot into the **owner's Ender Chest**
- Requires **Fabric API**
- Designed for **Minecraft 1.21.11**

---

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.11
- **Loader:** Fabric
- **Dependency:** Fabric API
- **Optional compatibility:** Farmers Delight

---

## Why Pocket Gnomes?

Pocket Gnomes is built around a simple idea:

**small magical companions that make survival more fun without turning the game into a full tech mod.**

It is meant to feel readable, flavorful, and charming:
three wands, three roles, three little helpers.
